title: Reject archive entries that escape the extraction root
description: The client's export service extracts uploaded zip archives under a per-tenant root. This change makes archive.EntryPath refuse entry names that would place a file outside that root.

acceptance_criteria.text: Empty and absolute entry names are rejected.
No entry name, including '..' and names that end in '..', produces a path outside root.
Names that stay inside root are joined unchanged.
